text: Well, speaking of ICE, Barbie, I can't think of anything more egregious, god-awful shameful than what we are doing to immigrants and people who are legally here. They're just rounding them up with a cattle truck and shipping them off. I did see a great cartoon this morning in the thing that my teacher sent me. It was homegrown criminals should be sent to El Salvador. And guess who was languishing there in a cell? Trump. Yep, it was perfect. It was one of his better cartoons. I'm sorry I didn't save it for you. But I mean, my grandfather was an illegal immigrant. How many people's ancestors were illegal immigrants? Everybody's. Yeah, my grandfather stowed away aboard a boat. He was a criminal and an illegal immigrant. And somehow he managed to run a successful farm, raise 10 children, four of whom served in World War II. and was a gem and a benefit to his community. And at some point, he became an American citizen, but I have no idea when or how. God, he might have been in one of those territories that wasn't a state until he lived there. Our friend had some relatives who were in Arizona from Mexico, and when Arizona became a state, they automatically became citizens, and had a very hard time proving it, because there was no paperwork.
